newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Soon Soon calls corn/soy tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Soon Soon calls corn/soy tender - trade.

text.p: Malaysia's Soon Soon Oilmills Sdn Bhd is expected to tender on Wednesday for a combined cargo of corn and soybeans totalling 55,000 tonnes, traders said on Tuesday.
"The consignment is for October shipment and November arrival," a trader in Singapore told Reuters.
A Soon Soon spokesman in Malaysia's northern Penang island declined to comment on the tender.
Another trader in Malaysia said the bid will, however, have little effect on the local grains market as there was a maize glut and trading was quiet in soymeal.
